title: Require Recipe Step Source Topology
forbids: recipe step source outside one closed kebab-case directory containing config.ts, step.ts, and at most the optional viz.ts support module
why: A recipe step has one closed filesystem container: config.ts declares its authored contract, step.ts owns execution and visibly attaches optional authoring capabilities, and viz.ts may hold substantial pure visualization projections behind that attachment. Loose helpers, nested implementation cabinets, barrels, and artifact authorities obscure ownership and let implementation concerns escape the executable owner.
remediate: Move each step beneath a kebab-case directory, retain required config.ts and step.ts plus viz.ts only when the step visibly attaches that visualization, inline private execution into step.ts, and relocate reusable capabilities or immutable products to their actual recipe, domain, SDK, diagnostics, metrics, or visualization owner.
message: Recipe step source must use one closed kebab-case container with config.ts, step.ts, and only its optional viz.ts support module.
